name: Dylanbrouwer
summary: A mixed brutalist portfolio style with concrete fields, cinder-black ink, one ember-orange accent, massive Tilt Warp display type, sharp project cards, and pill-only small controls.

cinderBlack.role: Main ink, borders, nav text, inverted surface

boneWhite.role: Light card surface, footer text, foreground on dark

concreteMist.role: Primary page background and neutral gallery field

emberOrange.role: Accent tags, hover fills, special CTA capsules

utilityGray.role: Metadata, counters, inactive links, secondary text

deepField.role: Full black panels and image-backed overlays

components.posterMasthead: Oversized Tilt Warp display lockup with sparse metadata and hard light/dark contrast.
components.pillNav: Compact uppercase pill links with black borders and orange or black hover fills.
components.projectCard: Sharp media block, title, category metadata, and optional orange capsule.
components.workIndexRow: Bordered horizontal row with project title, year, category, and hover reveal.
components.accentCapsule: Small pill badge using ember orange, black text, or inverted text depending on contrast.
components.mediaFrame: 0px radius image or screenshot block, usually full-width or grid-aligned.
components.darkPanel: Full-bleed black or cinder surface with bone-white type and restrained orange detail.

dos: Use huge display typography as the main visual device.
Keep ember orange rare and intentional.
Use sharp corners for all large surfaces.
Use pills only for small controls.
Use hard project imagery and sparse metadata.
donts: Do not round project cards or images.
Do not introduce extra accent colors.
Do not reduce the hero to polite marketing scale.
Do not create dense copy-heavy sections.
